Siriraj Admission Note — Fill & Print Tool (Page 1–2)

Phaco:
Type into the form below, then Print. The printed page includes the form itself AND your typed answers together, on plain paper — you do not need to feed any pre-printed form into the printer.
In the print dialog, please check: Paper size: A4, Scale: 100% / Default / Actual size (not "Fit to page"), and Margins: None. These are set by the page itself but some print dialogs override them, so it's worth a glance the first time you print on a given computer.
